title: Chapter 605
paragraphs: Chapter 605
Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (9)
Jin and the Demon Kings gathered in front of Chaos, which had transformed into a door. Although Ban showed anger, Chaos showed no reaction, as if it had truly become an object.
"It looked like Brother Jin was going to win... Did it run away?"
"I wouldn't say it ran away. It feels like Chaos has become the door itself. Strange fellow. As if it wasn't the original Chaos."
This time, Jin couldn't go in right away.
'Its thoughts have been blocked. It's not that he isn't speaking, but as soon as he turned into a door, he completely cut off.'
The last thing he felt from Chaos's inner thoughts was that this door was his secret weapon.
"Brothers, I was able to read the thoughts of Chaos until just now. That's why I was able to deal with his attacks smoothly."
As Jin explained the situation, sighs flowed among the Demon Kings.
"It seemed like it would be solved easily thanks to the divine fusion, but it's one mountain after another."
"Still, Brother Jin has recovered his power faster and more than we thought, so there must be a way. The divine fusion is not yet released."
The divine fusion remained even after Chaos transformed into a door.
However, unlike the other brothers, Jin and Ban thought it was a problem. Jin didn't know when he would lose consciousness, and Ban was continually transferring energy to Jin.
"Brothers, it seems like we need some time to think. Let's go somewhere else and talk for now."
Jin and the Demon Kings left the training ground, leaving two ordinary warriors as guards, and fortunately, the divine fusion between Jin and Ban was released as soon as they were 1 mile away.
'She doesn't show it, but it seems that Brother Ban is a little tired...'
Ban, the divine being, originally had an almost infinite amount of energy.
But as she expressed herself, her heyday had passed long ago.
She lost some of her power at the moment of the Demon Kings' destruction half a million years ago, and weakened several times while transferring divine energy to Jin.
Therefore, for Ban now, the divine fusion was a kind of forced amplification, a somewhat strenuous act.
The energy was not being controlled as she wanted, and the efficiency of Jin receiving that power was not good.
The other Demon Kings could not even imagine that Ban could be 'just' that tired.
Naturally, all the Demon Kings' eyes gathered on Boras.
"Brother Otu King, do you have any idea this time?"
"Yeah, Brother Otu King is a genius. You have some thoughts, right?"
Boras scratched the back of his head, laughing awkwardly.

"Well, I don't really have anything in mind either. The divine fusion, Jin reading Chaos's thoughts, Chaos turning into that door... all of these are first-time occurrences. Let's watch for a few days and think together about what to do."
Chaos continued to maintain the form of a door even after a week had passed.
In the meantime, Jin spent his time training or participating in various experiments with his brothers (on how the door works), and only two things were definitely found out.
First, the only person who can enter the door of Chaos is Jin, and second, the door cannot be rung through the spirit sword.
When someone other than Jin tried to enter the door, a strong repulsion occurred.
Most of Jin's lost power is still tied to Chaos. He couldn't see it like when Chaos was in the form of a dragon, but he could feel it.
Even when he unfolded the spirit sword, the door momentarily blurred like water and quickly regained its form.
They didn't even attempt to attack with the Demon Kings' brain power, fearing that Chaos might be hurt.
Phoenix Tess, who had always been a breakthrough solution at such moments, could not be summoned. This place, Lafrarosa, is a dead world.
"In the end, the only way is for Brother Jin to go beyond the door."
"It seems so, Brother Divinity. After all, the last thought he conveyed to me was that I would no longer be able to receive help from my brothers."
Stepping into an unknown trap is not a difficult task if you just steel your heart.
The problem was the fact that, after entering the door, there was a high possibility that the brothers would have a hard time responding if something unexpected happened that Jin couldn't handle.
Anyway, the Demon Kings decided to gather and wait in front of the door. Jin was ready to leave with a backpack full of cocktail and water.
"Ah, should we really let Brother Jin go like this?"
"Brother Jin, it may be hard to accept... but even if you lose a little power, what about traveling with other brothers?"
"I can't do that, brothers."
"Sigh, I said something unnecessary. It wasn't a thoughtless remark without considering Brother Jin's sense of loss."
"Why are you explaining even that? We all understand. Maybe things will work out better than expected inside the door, so don't worry too much. I'll be back."
"May luck be with you, brother."
"I hope that Brother Divinity's power will continue to be with you even when you step inside..."
The Demon Kings felt like they were sending a child out to sea alone. Jin waved at them as if he was fine, but he was just as anxious.
Whoosh-!
As soon as he stepped beyond the door, the landscape changed unexpectedly.
'I somewhat expected it, but it's similar to when I entered Guryeok's subspace.'
In the midst of total abnormal darkness, only Jin's silhouette was clear. This kind of subspace was not new to Jin now.
Do I have to go forward aimlessly again…..
Just as he thought that, a low and gloomy breath came from somewhere.
[Welcome...]
It had not been 10 seconds since Jin entered the subspace.
Jin naturally lifted his head to find the direction of the voice, and he was taken aback.
'Insane!'
Because he had met the eyes of Chaos.
He was big enough when he was in the training ground, but now it was different. One eye was large enough to overwhelm Jin.
He was tensed enough to make his hair stand on end, but Jin soon swung his Bradamante and cut off the eye of Chaos that seemed to cover him.
Clang-!
The sensation was like striking an ancient iron, and it was rather Jin who took the hit.
With just one blow, he could tell.
The fact that he cannot beat him now.
'Even if the divine fusion is not broken, there's not even a scratch left...!?'

He couldn't guarantee it even before losing his power. The only strategy is to retreat. The situation is even more burdensome than when he first extracted him, let alone things working out better than expected.
[Divine fusion, that's what you call it? Because the power of that monster resonates with my remnants left in you, you're saying it was quite a struggle.]
It was an even more desperate situation.
In the training ground, Jin unilaterally read Chaos's thoughts, but here it was the opposite. Chaos was looking into Jin's mind.
When he hurriedly turned around, he couldn't see the door. When he remembered that he hadn't taken five steps past the door, he was on the verge of laughing in vain.
'It's the worst. There's nothing worse than this, even considering all the cases I discussed with my brothers.'
Bang-!
Jin's head spun for a moment from the impact that seemed to make his body disappear. It was the result of Chaos's giant forefoot, which had not been visible, striking Jin sideways.
[It's a powerful forefoot swing that you didn't taste last time! Kya kya kya.]
With that one blow, all the bones and organs in his body were shaken, and blood spurted from every hole in his face. If he hadn't been protected by the spirit armor, he would have died instantly.
He was not angry or in pain.
He was just dumbfounded.
'There's no such scam as this.'
[Exactly! That's how I felt. It was nice when you and the monsters were beating me up, wasn't it? How does it feel to be on the receiving end?]
"It doesn't seem like a story worth listening to from someone who stole all my power."
Jin spoke calmly, but inside he was frantically thinking.
[Are you wondering why the door disappeared, thinking about a way to get out?]
Another powerful swing of the forefoot, the area was too large to avoid. Even if it was small, it wasn't a speed he could avoid.
Jin barely held onto his consciousness.
He never thought he would feel so powerless with almost 30% of his strength recovered and the divine fusion still in effect!
There was no door. Then, he had to create one. Fortunately, Jin had experienced something similar in the past.
Whooong-!
Spiritual energy wrapped around Bradamante.
[Your power is not much of a threat to me here.]
"Is that so?"
Instead of aiming at him, Jin swung Bradamante at the empty space one step ahead.
Unbelievably, the space tore apart, and an escape route formed. Through the gap, he could see the training ground of Lafralosa and his waiting brothers.
'He didn't read that I had escaped such a space using a spirit sword before.'
Whether he couldn't read it or he intentionally left a gap knowing it, it wasn't a matter to worry about now. He had to think about what to do after escaping.
Jin, who threw his body into the crack created by the spirit sword, was burning with more intense determination than ever before, regardless of his urgency.
'I'll become stronger and end this, definitely.'
Kigigigig-!
Just before Jin escaped through the crack, hundreds of black spikes suddenly formed in the air and stabbed him like arrows. The spikes created by Chaos
struck Jin like crazy in that short gap, but they couldn't penetrate the spirit armor.
"Ugh, gasp!"
"Jin, brother!?"
"You're already back, no! Jin, brother, blood!"
"Voras, brother! Treat Jin, brother, right away...!"
Thud!
As soon as Jin collapsed on the training ground floor, the Demon King's tribesmen rushed over and shouted.
Jin could hardly hear their voices.
Instead, Jin stared at the gap he had escaped from until his consciousness faded, lying down.
With a blind determination to take revenge.
'I'll kill you... by any means necessary.'
And Chaos, unlike the appearance he had shown so far, stared at Jin beyond the crack with a stern expression, watching the gap close quickly as he escaped.
When the gap was completely closed and his space was once again filled with the emptiness of Chaos's darkness, he muttered to himself.
[Hmph, come back again. You foolish brat!]
